name: MC_PRICER_METADATA
description: This table contains a variety of metadata returned from the Epic Pricer.

columns.name: PRICER_MSG_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the Epic Pricer message record.

columns.name: MC_PRICER_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The pricer type calculated by the Epic Pricer.

columns.name: PRICER_RETURN_CODE
columns.description: The return code returned from the Epic Pricer.

columns.name: PRICER_PROV_CCN
columns.description: The CMS Certified Numer (CCN) used when the Epic Pricer was invoked.

columns.name: PRICER_CCN_EFF_DATE
columns.description: The effective date associated with the CCN in column PRICER_PROV_CCN for the Epic Pricer.

columns.name: MC_PRICER_PROV_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Instituional provider type defined by CMS.
entries: Re-based Sole Community Hospital/ Referral Center

columns.name: MPFS_STATUS_INDICATOR_C_NAME
columns.description: The status indicator returned for a service priced using a physician fee schedule. The released values are extracted from the CMS Medicare physician fee schedule and are owned by CMS.
entries: Excluded from fee schedule by regulation

columns.name: ASC_PAYMENT_INDICATOR_C_NAME
columns.description: The payment indicator returned for a service priced using an ASC fee schedule. The released values are extracted from the CMS ASC fee schedule and are owned by CMS.
